name: augenta
description: Augenta — opt-in, per-project capture of your coding agent's activity and project memory to the Augenta Neurospaces you select. Ask "Connect Augenta" in a project to enable it.

interface.longDescription: Augenta captures your coding agent's activity and matching project memory from projects you explicitly connect, and ships them to your Augenta Neurospace through a Neurolink. Nothing is captured until you connect a project.
